input: Renew my first aid certification before it lapses

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The expiry date determines urgency and how much time is available to find and book a course — a cert lapsing in 2 weeks needs a very different plan than one lapsing in 3 months.
First aid certifications vary widely (basic CPR/AED, standard first aid, wilderness, pediatric, workplace-level) — the type dictates which providers and courses are even valid options.
Whether this is a personal requirement or mandated by an employer or organization affects who selects the provider, who pays, and whether a specific accreditation body is required.
In-person, blended (online theory + in-person skills), or fully online courses differ in scheduling flexibility, cost, and whether they are accepted by the user's certifying body or employer.
The user's location determines which providers and course dates are realistically accessible — some areas have very limited options or long waitlists.
The user may have a strong preference for a specific provider (e.g., Red Cross, St. John Ambulance) or want the cheapest option — this shapes which courses to prioritize.
Knowing what 'done' looks like — a digital card, a physical certificate, an employer record updated — clarifies what must happen after passing the course for the task to be truly complete.
